001: Haoran, can you help me move this box?
Of course, where are you moving it to?
To that office on the third floor, it's a bit heavy.
No problem, I'll help you carry it up.
Thank you so much, I definitely couldn't move it by myself.
Don't mention it, friends should help each other.
002: Jingyi, my phone suddenly died, can I borrow yours?
Sure, are you going to make a call?
Yes, I want to let my mom know I'm safe.
Here you go, just leave it on the table when you're done.
Okay, I'll give it back to you as soon as I'm finished.
No rush, take your time, I'll go get busy first.
003: Sir, is there a subway station nearby?
Yes, go straight ahead, turn right at the intersection and you'll be there.
About how long will it take to walk?
If you walk, about ten minutes or so.
Okay, thank you for telling me.
You're welcome, be careful on the way.
004: Tianyou, I just can't figure out this math problem.
Let me take a look, which part are you confused about?
It's the last step, I don't know how to simplify it.
Oh, you need to use this formula here, see.
So that's how it works, I get it now, thank you.
You're welcome, feel free to ask me anytime if you have questions.
005: Hello, could you take a photo for me?
Of course, where do you want to take it?
Right in front of this sculpture, take a full-body shot of me.
Okay, stand still, I'll count one, two, three and take it.
How did it turn out? Let me see.
It's pretty good, but the lighting is a bit dark, let me take another one for you.
006: Jiaqi, can you help me figure out how to print this document?
Sure, first open it, then click print.
I clicked it, but the printer isn't responding.
Did you select the wrong printer? Let me take a look for you.
I think I really did pick the wrong one, it works now.
Good, just call me again if you have trouble later.
007: Zixuan, I think I left my keys in the classroom.
What are you going to do? Want me to go back with you to look for them?
That would be great, I'm a bit scared to go alone.
It's fine, I'll go with you, the classroom probably isn't locked yet.
Found them! They were right in my desk drawer, I was so scared.
Glad you found them, next time remember to put them in your bag.
008: Ma'am, is there a pharmacy nearby?
Yes, go out and turn left, walk for a bit and you'll see it.
I have a bit of a cold, I want to buy some medicine.
That pharmacy is pretty big, they have all kinds of medicine.
You're welcome, hurry on over, don't delay.
009: Junjie, can you help me carry these books?
That's a lot of books, where are you taking them?
To the library to return them, I can't carry all of these by myself.
Alright, I'll carry half for you, let's go together.
Thanks so much, I'll treat you to bubble tea later.
010: Yuxuan, my computer suddenly froze, can you take a look?
Let me see, what were you doing just now?
Just doing my homework, and it suddenly froze.
Maybe you have too many programs open, let me restart it for you.
It's working again! My files are still here, thank you so much.
You're welcome, next time remember to save often.
